claims.value: Saint-Cyr gives side A about 15,000 bayonets and 1,500 sabres for the march toward Barcelona after Rosas; Reille was left behind.
claims.rationale: Marching relief force, not a same-moment engaged return; Reille’s absent division is not included. English rendering (ours): "The commander-in-chief had to march on the provincial capital with about 15,000 bayonets and 1,500 sabres, Reille’s division remaining in the Ampurdán to garrison Figueres and Roses."

citations.locator: saint-cyr, printed p. 53, Internet Archive leaf 57; inspected page-image excerpt
citations.quote: Il fallait donc que le général en chef marchât sur la capitale de la province avec environ quinze mille baïonnettes et quinze cents sabres, la division Reille devant rester dans le Lampourdan pour former les garnisons de Figuières et de Roses

claims.value: Saint-Cyr estimates side B at 15,000 attacked at Llinas, built from about 10,000 with Reding and 5,000 brought by Vives.
claims.rationale: Interested French opponent estimate, explicitly arguing against Spanish reports. Bodart’s 9,000 is retained; Milans’s nearby force is not assumed engaged. English rendering (ours): "It had about 10,000 leaving Barcelona; with the five [thousand] brought by Vives, that made the 15,000 we attacked at Llinas."

citations.locator: saint-cyr, printed p. 64, Internet Archive leaf 68; inspected page-image excerpt
citations.quote: elle avait environ dix mille hommes en partant de Barcelonne, ce qui, joint aux cinq amenés par Vivès, forme les quinze mille que nous avons attaqués à Llinas.

claims.value: Toreno places Reding on the Spanish right and the Vique somaten on the opposite flank, under the Spanish chief’s field disposition.
claims.rationale: Vives is the general named in the immediately preceding context; Reding’s contingent command is not a second whole-army attribution. English rendering (ours): "He formed his column for battle and deployed on the right under Reding; the Vique somaten occupied the opposite flank."

citations.locator: toreno-t2, printed p. 259, Internet Archive leaf 264; inspected page-image excerpt
citations.quote: Formó su columna en batalla, y desplegó sobre la derecha que mandaba Reding, ocupando el costado opuesto de la línea el somaten de Vique.

claims.value: Toreno identifies Pino beginning the French attack under express orders from the commander-in-chief.
claims.rationale: Saint-Cyr is named in the preceding paragraph. The source’s later criticism of execution is not a causal score. English rendering (ours): "Pino’s division began the attack with express orders not to deviate from the commander-in-chief’s decision."

claims.value: The French chief intended to break through the Spanish centre in one column.
claims.rationale: English rendering (ours): "As the French general’s object was to pass at all costs, he decided to fight in one column breaking through the Spaniards."

claims.value: The French immediate object was to pass through the Spanish force.
claims.rationale: English rendering (ours): "The French general’s object was to pass at all costs."

claims.value: Saint-Cyr says the French had consumed their biscuit, had less than an hour’s infantry ammunition and no cannon.
claims.rationale: Interested commander’s report of his constraint, not a readiness score or measured cause of victory. English rendering (ours): "The Bisbal biscuit was consumed; earlier fighting had used part of the cartridges, leaving less than an hour’s ammunition, meaning only infantry cartridges, as the French had no cannon."

citations.locator: saint-cyr, printed p. 64, Internet Archive leaf 68; inspected page-image excerpt
citations.quote: Le biscuit distribué à la Bisbal était consommé; les cartouches l’avaient été, en partie, dans les combats des journées précédentes, de sorte qu’il ne restait pas de munitions pour une heure de combat; encore par munitions, il faut entendre seulement les cartouches d’infanterie, car les Français n’avaient point de canons.

claims.value: Toreno places the Spanish defence on the ridge beyond Cardedeu and Villalba ending at the Riera de la Roca.
claims.rationale: English rendering (ours): "Positioned on the ridge beyond Cardedeu and Villalba ending at the Riera de la Roca."

Source dependence: Bodart is a later compilation. Toreno, Foy, Oman, Saint-Cyr and the official Correspondance are interested or retrospective source families, and embedded/reprinted reports are not extra independent witnesses. Agreement does not establish independence.
